name: Marquardt modular multilevel converter topology
description: Rainer Marquardt devised a voltage-source converter with series-connected submodules that each store energy in a local capacitor and switch independently. Anton Lesnicar and Marquardt subsequently described the topology and simulated a high-voltage network intertie.

date.basis: The application front matter gives the filing date.

events.statement: Marquardt filed a German patent application for converter circuits with distributed energy storage.

evidence.supports: Dates the filing and describes the switchable local storage and series-connected subsystems.

evidence.locator: A milestone in modern power conversion; Engineering the backbone of future energy systems
evidence.supports: Identifies the 2001 filing and explains the independently switched submodules.

date.basis: The copyright year and conference proceedings identify 2003.

events.statement: Lesnicar and Marquardt described the modular multilevel topology for high-voltage power interties and reported a simulation of a 36 MW intertie.
events.scope: Design description and simulation of the converter’s intertie application.

evidence.supports: Describes the arrangement and identifies the 36 MW result as simulated.
